newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Aug 14.

text.p: -- Micron Technology Inc shares rebounded overnight in London after being heavily sold Wednesday. Micron's share price sank 14 percent yesterday -- it was the day's most active issue -- as the market worried about falling chip prices and other industry issues.
-- Shares of Rambus Inc rose to 69 after the close Wednesday following a day in which the semiconductor equipment maker's stock soared as high as 75 before closing at 67-3/4.
-- Lucent Technologies will take an after-tax charge of $950 million, or $1.47 per share, related to its $1.8 billion acquisition of Octel Communications, the Wall Street Journal reported.
-- ABC Television ordered layoffs of about 200 workers as it prepares to submit its annual budget to parent company Walt Disney Co, the New York Times reported.
-- Network General Corp said it will buy back an additional 4.0 million common shares under its July 1993 buyback program.
-- Insight Enterprises Inc said it set a three-for-two stock split.
